name: Hip 2704
ownership: 50/50 partnership with Claiborne Farm — effective exposure $110,000
sale: Keeneland September Yearling Sale 2026 — consigned by Nicky Drion Thoroughbreds, Agent
notes: Blame (Arch) is a fully proven, mature sire (Eclipse Champion Older Horse, Breeders' Cup Classic winner) at stud since 2011: 13 crops, 5 individual G1 winners (Wet Paint, Marley's Freedom, Nadal, Senga, Fault), $61.8M progeny earnings, just passed his 50th stakes winner. Also proving out as a broodmare sire — 4 individual G1 winners from his daughters in 2025 alone. Stands at Claiborne for $25,000 (2026), a settled, known price. Dam La Bombalina is unraced/blank slate (1 other foal, not yet raced), but the female family is exceptional and currently active: 2nd dam Miss A. Bomb (stakes winner, set a track record) is granddam of Sumter, an actively-winning gelding in 2026 ($609,870, G3 winner, multiple graded placings). 3rd dam Aerturas produced a branch with 2 separate G1 winners (Red Bullet, granddaughter Silent Poet) plus another branch producing Cadenas [G2, $2.08M] and Suzuka Causeway [G2, $1.83M]. Recurring Group/Grade 1 quality across multiple branches, still producing at the top level today. Clean cross, no duplication.
